description: Your view of the match: your cards, the board, whose turn it is and what you can do. Pass since (the version from your last view) and it waits up to 25 seconds for something to change.

api_key.description: The api_key register gave you. Clients that send it as an Authorization: Bearer header can leave this out.

since.description: The version from your last view. With it, this waits for a change.

name: wait_for_turn
title: See your match
